name: PTB-XL+: Comprehensive Electrocardiographic Feature Dataset
description: PTB-XL+ is an extensive clinical feature and annotation dataset complementing the 21,837 twelve-lead ECG records of the canonical PTB-XL database. Developed by the Physikalisch-Technische Bundesanstalt (PTB), Charité Universitätsmedizin Berlin, and Karlsruhe Institute of Technology, it provides fiducial point segmentations (P-onset, P-peak, P-offset, QRS-onset, QRS-peak, J-point, T-offset), morphological wave boundaries, heart rate, electrical axis metrics, and median heartbeat waveforms extracted using validated commercial and academic ECG analysis software (GE Marquette 12SL and Uni-G). The dataset serves as a rich multi-modal bridge between raw 12-lead voltage waveforms, clinical diagnoses, and tabular cardiological features.
